title: PHI de-identification for logs, prompts and traces
area: HIPAA in AI pipelines: minimum necessary and de-identification
scenario: Kestrel wants to export LangGraph traces and logs to a tracing tool outside the BAA and to build eval sets from cases. Build the layer in front of every log handler, prompt builder and span exporter: a minimum-necessary context, keyed pseudonyms, identifier redaction that keeps clinical content, and a logging filter that cannot be bypassed by args, extras or exceptions.
task: Keyed member pseudonyms and names from the FHIR Patient
Redact identifiers in text and nested objects, keep clinical content
Minimum-necessary context for the criteria step and a clean prompt
Logging filter and span scrubber that catch args, extras, f-strings and exceptions
acceptance: Planted identifiers in many formats never reach output
ICD codes, doses, durations and policy ids survive
Prompt, context, handler output and spans are clean
